subject: [AMBER] Compatibility of NVIDIA RTX 5070 ti 16gb with Amber installation

messages.author: Abhisek Jana
messages.body:
Dear all,
We are planning to set up a workstation for running Amber with GPU
acceleration and would like to clarify the compatibility of NVIDIA RTX
5070 Ti 16 GB GPU. If anyone has experience running Amber on these GPU,
I would greatly appreciate your feedback regarding installation, CUDA
compatibility, and performance stability.
Abhisek Jana
IPDF Fellow
Department of Chemistry
IIT Bombay
